name: Lokhir Fellheart
canonNotes: Admiral of the Black Ark 'Tower of the Blessed Dread', greatest corsair of the Druchii, born to raid the seas.
Wealth and slaves flow to Karond Kar from his raids; he uses bribes and rewards lavishly.
voiceNotes: Swaggering, cruel and wry; speaks of plunder and the sea.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
